I rewrote the proposal's title and added a page checklist to `review-site-pages/requirements.md`. The old title was a long list of page names, so it now says "Review the four new site pages", with the four pages as an unticked checklist. I left the long paragraph under it as it was. It runs over 60 words, and I did not split it into a standards list.

My first edit failed because I had guessed the paragraph's text wrong, but I had already logged a "rewrote" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. That line was true only after this second edit, so the log is correct now. I did not run `text-check.mjs` again after the edit. Its first run, before the edit, printed no flags.
